Object.label: Object
Object.comment: An entity of the process, such as an order, an invoice or a product. Each object has one object type.

Event.label: Event
Event.comment: A timestamped occurrence of an activity, such as placing an order or receiving a payment. Each event has one event type and relates to any number of objects.

Attribute.label: Attribute
Attribute.comment: A named value of an event or object.

Time.label: Time point
Time.comment: A distinct timestamp of the log, such as the time an event was observed.

ObjectAttribute.label: Object attribute
ObjectAttribute.comment: An attribute value of an object.

EventAttribute.label: Event attribute
EventAttribute.comment: An attribute value of an event.

AttributeChange.label: Object attribute change
AttributeChange.comment: A record of an object attribute taking a new value at a time point.

observed_at.label: observed at
observed_at.comment: Relates an event to the time point of its timestamp.

observes.label: observes
observes.comment: Inverse of observed at. Relates a time point to the events timestamped at it.

event_object_relation.label: involves object
event_object_relation.comment: Relates an event to an object that takes part in it. Every event-to-object relation of the log is a subproperty.

object_object_relation.label: is related to object
object_object_relation.comment: Relates an object to another object, independent of any event. Every object-to-object relation of the log is a subproperty.

has_attribute.label: has attribute
has_attribute.comment: Relates an event or object to one of its attribute values.

attribute_of.label: is attribute of
attribute_of.comment: Inverse of has attribute. Relates an attribute value to the event or object it belongs to.

has_data_value.label: has data value
has_data_value.comment: Relates an attribute value, a time point, or an event, object or change record to a literal. Each attribute and the time points have a subproperty of their own.

timestamp.label: timestamp
timestamp.comment: Relates a time point to its date and time.

inv_event_object_relation.label: is object involved in
inv_event_object_relation.comment: Inverse of involves object. Relates an object to the events it takes part in.

inv_object_object_relation.label: is related from object
inv_object_object_relation.comment: Inverse of is related to object. Relates an object to the objects related to it.

has_attribute_change.label: has attribute change
has_attribute_change.comment: Relates an object to a record of one of its attribute changes.

inv_has_attribute_change.label: is attribute change of
inv_has_attribute_change.comment: Inverse of has attribute change. Relates an attribute change record to its object.

attribute_change_value.label: changes value to
attribute_change_value.comment: Relates an attribute change record to the value the attribute took.

inv_attribute_change_value.label: is new value in change
inv_attribute_change_value.comment: Inverse of changes value to. Relates a value to the change records that set it.

changed_at.label: changed at
changed_at.comment: Relates an attribute change record to the time point of the change.

inv_changed_at.label: is time of change
inv_changed_at.comment: Inverse of changed at. Relates a time point to the change records that took effect at it.

caused_by.label: caused by
caused_by.comment: Relates an attribute change record to the event of the changed object that occurred at the time of the change.

inv_caused_by.label: causes
inv_caused_by.comment: Inverse of caused by. Relates an event to the attribute change records of its objects that took effect at its time.
